an5.44:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.44:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Uggassa gahapatino Vesālikassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an5.44:1.3: Atha kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.44:2.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:2.4: taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:3.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:3.4: taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:4.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:4.4: taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:5.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:5.3: Manāpo me bhante sālīnaṃ odano vigatakāḷako anekasūpo anekavyañjano,
an5.44:5.4: taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:6.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:6.4: tāni me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:7.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:7.3: Manāpo me bhante pallaṅko gonakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sa-uttaracchado ubhato lohitakūpadhāno.
an5.44:7.4: Api ca bhante mayam p'etaṃ jānāma
an5.44:7.6: idaṃ me bhante candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikasatasahassaṃ,
an5.44:7.7: taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an5.44:7.9: Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumodi.
an5.44:10.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an5.44:11.1: Atha kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko aparena samayena kālam akāsi,
an5.44:11.2: kālakato ca Uggo gahapati Vesāliko aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji.
an5.44:11.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.44:11.4: Atha kho Uggo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Uggaṃ devaputtaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:--
an5.44:11.7: Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
